Noah: Totally hypothetical quick poll: tiny smoke, one second to grab ONE editor and one snack. Which editor gets the rescue and what snack do you pocket? Drop editor + snack or react. :fire: :chipmunk:
Rina: VS Code + granola bar. Can't live without settings sync and extensions. :one:
Ollie: Neovim + trail mix. Fingers know the keys, and small snacks fit pockets. :two:
Noah: Options (react):
  :one: VS Code
  :two: Neovim
  :three: Emacs
  :four: Helix
  :five: Nano
Rina: reacted :one: - also saves my workspace layouts.
Ollie: reacted :two: - dotfiles are irreplaceable.
DevOpsBot: Reminder: Fire drill later today at 4pm. This is a mock scenario, please refrain from actual arson. :robot_face:

Rina: Emacs + chocolate. Id carry a tiny chocolate bar and a copy of Org mode.
Ollie: Helix + mints if I'm feeling modern.
Noah: Honorable mentions: Kakoune, Sublime, VSCodium.
Rina: Quick tally from emoji reactions: VS Code 1, Neovim 1, others 0  tie so far.
